assertions.name: zero_nontrivial_substrate_q_rationals_within_one_percent
assertions.unit: count of non-classical-limit-trivial candidates with |value - π²/720| / (π²/720) < 1%
assertions.source: Empirical null-result assertion: π²/720 is NOT a low-degree substrate q-rational at q_0.  Counts candidates from candidate_q_rationals + substrate_quantity_candidates after filtering out forms of shape a·π²/(720·[m]_q^p) with a == m^p (those match trivially by q → 1 continuity).  Asserts the filtered count is 0; passing this assertion is the null result the audit reports.

description: Empirical search for a q-rational expression at substrate q ≈ 1.1100 matching the standard Casimir prefactor π²/720 ≈ 1.372e-2.  Tabulates ζ_q(s) for s = 1..4, damped cubic mode sums Σ [n]_q³·q⁻ᵏⁿ for k = 3..15, and low-degree q-rationals a·π²/(720·[m]_q).  Reports the closest match and its residue.  A null result (no match within 1e-3) is acceptable — it documents that the π²/720 prefactor is not a trivially-q-rational object at q_0, tightening sub-problem (3) of conj:casimir-epsilon-vacuum.

best_match_overall.note: May be a classical-limit-trivial match (form a·π²/(720·[m]_q^p) with a == m^p, recovering π²/720 by continuity as q → 1).  See best_nontrivial_match for the actual signal.
